mapper.sql: id, user_id AS userId, provider, provider_user_id AS providerUserId, provider_email AS providerEmail, linked_at AS linkedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_social_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY linked_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_social_accounts (user_id, provider, provider_user_id, provider_email, linked_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{provider}, #{providerUserId}, #{providerEmail}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider_user_id = VALUES(provider_user_id), provider_email = VALUES(provider_email), linked_at = NOW()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_social_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND provider = #{provider}
